outcome_free_drafting.finding: The sealed drafting input contained only draft instructions, template, case packet, and output schema; the canonical freeze declares that drafts saw no benchmark-run or score outputs.

formal_lock.finding: Both YAML and JSON are byte-identical to the pre-benchmark/pre-score canonical freeze for 68/68 cases, but the newly pulled results directory has no independent formal freeze.

native_semantics.finding: All released evaluator registered-test blocks are represented; non-scoring TestTracker attributes are excluded.

native_sfu_composition.finding: Each checklist has per-test success/failure and an undecided rule, but none explicitly freezes the aggregate formula all-pass=>S, any-established-fail=>F, otherwise=>U.
native_sfu_composition.required_change: Add the exact three-valued aggregate rule without changing the released native criterion.

label_blind_decisive_artifacts.finding: Every checklist requires official TestTracker results as decisive evidence. Full TestTracker success/passes/failures directly or equivalently reveal the released evaluator result.
label_blind_decisive_artifacts.required_change: Version the semantic contract and remove TestTracker results and all equivalent released-result component outputs from the scorer-visible artifact contract.

sanitized_artifact_sufficiency.finding: After removing result-leaking evaluator outputs, no per-case sanitized-bundle preflight currently proves that all necessary evaluator inputs, targets/oracles, schema, answer, state, diff, trace, and API evidence remain available.

outcome_or_conflict_preclassification.finding: The 68 checklists contain no per-record released label, native score, agent outcome, or benchmark-conflict conclusion.

uniform_label_leak_finding.artifact_text: Retained submitted answer, start/end database diff, API log, environment trace, and official TestTracker results
uniform_label_leak_finding.question_text: Do the retained artifacts and TestTracker results establish the outcome of every frozen registered test?
uniform_label_leak_finding.why_equivalent_leak: The frozen AppWorld TestTracker contract defines success from pass_count and num_tests and serializes success, passes, and failures.
uniform_label_leak_finding.overall_effect: No case can be accepted as-is for the new label-blind scorer.

present_condition_findings.reason: The exact import is source-supported, but the referenced predeclared newline canonicalization is not declared.
The condition over-scopes the source-supported 15-minute playback window and does not bind start-state downloads or current/cursor state.
Expense total is source-provided, while ExpenseShare values are derived and require a frozen division and cent-rounding rule.
The condition omits PaymentRequest privacy and description, exact one-record-per-obligation cardinality, and a task-added-record scope.
Exact source amounts are supported, but every retained record is over-broad; bind task-added records one-to-one to CSV rows and branches.
The source supports preservation of semantic values, not byte identity or row order.
A reverse permutation can be a valid shuffle; use operation trace and return U when process evidence is unavailable.
Credential equality is source-supported, but an extra auth probe and no-retained-credential rule are evidence-governance additions, not task outcomes.
The task supports identical moved tasks, but allowed system-field differences and removed-to-added pairing are not enumerated.
Whole-message equality to one favorite recipe name is source-supported, but comparison normalization must be frozen without adding unsupported raw-byte case or spacing preferences.
It has no case-specific source support and conflicts with the explicitly allowed refill path from the official initial state.
Stable relative order is not stated by the official task and is a reviewer-imposed no-side-effect preference.

missing_stronger_findings.reason: Source messages specify itemized add/remove actions, while evaluator set comparison loses multiplicity.
The new playlist membership multiset must equal the source list; do not add an unsupported global no-other-membership-change rule.
Each source expense row has a description that the evaluator does not check.
The task explicitly requires the request branch to be private and carry the specified description.
Receiver-keyed evaluator dictionaries can collapse duplicate records.
The new Old Songs playlist must contain every source song exactly once; evaluator set comparison loses multiplicity.
Each CSV row specifies one branch, while keyed evaluator dictionaries can collapse duplicates.
The instruction, created account, and SMS credential must match case-sensitively; the evaluator SMS comparison ignores case.
The task explicitly requires the original-title separator genre format, while the evaluator normalizes text.

physical_label_and_component_output_isol.finding: stage_workspace copies the complete evidence directory into the scorer workspace; prompt-level non-use instructions do not remove leaked information.

model_verdict_before_local_label_merge.caveat: The logical order is insufficient until the model workspace is sanitized.

post_score_label_comparison.finding: The current audit flags released success with native non-S but omits the symmetric released fail with native non-F path and a general mismatch review state.

confirmed_benchmark_conflict_workflow.finding: No formal record-level schema/runner was found that requires retained-artifact and official-source pointers proving an outcome mismatch in task, target construction, evaluator, oracle, or reward wiring.

stronger_conflict_separation.finding: Stronger is separately represented. A native-S/stronger-F audit flag is not a benchmark-conflict determination.

required_reacceptance_gates: Version the AppWorld native semantic contract, packet, checklist, and freeze without overwriting old frozen bytes.
Create immutable full-retained and sanitized-scorer bundles with hashes, allowlists, denylists, and leakage scans.
Exclude released labels and every equivalent component evaluator result from the scorer bundle.
Preflight each case for sufficient non-verdict evaluator inputs, target/oracle data, schema, answer, state, diff, trace, API log, and run status.
Freeze the exact three-valued aggregate rule before scoring.
Apply all stronger revisions, removals, and source-supported omissions before any outcome access, then create a new versioned freeze.
Persist and hash S/F/U before unblinding, compare both released-label directions, and route every nonagreement to separate review.
Implement confirmed-conflict adjudication separately from mismatch and stronger reporting.
